clinical_problem: Segmenting anatomical structures in standard fetal abdominal ultrasound sections to reduce missed diagnoses from unclear organ identification
model_description: SEG-FAUSP, a deep learning multi-task model with a parallel dual-branch semantic segmentation network, segments core anatomical structures (umbilical veins, gastric bubble, spine, bladder, inferior vena cava) in seven key fetal abdominal ultrasound sections.
title: SEG-FAUSP: Anatomical Structure Segmentation of the Standard Sections of Fetal Abdominal Ultrasounds.
headline_result: IoU >0.84 for bladder and gastric bubble; segmentation of complex structures (e.g., inferior vena cava) significantly superior to baseline

clinical_problem: Mapping the intellectual structure and growth of AI and deep learning research in pediatric radiology and medical imaging
model_description: A bibliometric analysis of 2,688 articles and conference proceedings (2005-2025) on AI/deep learning in pediatric radiology, using Bibliometrix R and VOSviewer to map publication growth, thematic clusters, and geographic co-authorship patterns.
title: Bibliometric Analysis of Artificial Intelligence in Pediatric Radiology and Medical Imaging: A Focus on Deep Learning Applications.
study_design: bibliometric analysis (Web of Science Core Collection, Bibliometrix/VOSviewer)
headline_result: Publications grew from 7 (2005) to 559 (2025); most-cited: Kermany et al. 2018 (2886 citations); 8 of top 10 productive affiliations North American

patient_population: 21,581 adult and pediatric X-rays from 20 countries
clinical_problem: Detecting 18 thoracic and musculoskeletal pathologies on conventional radiography across adult and pediatric patients
model_description: A unified deep learning radiographic AI suite validated for detecting 18 thoracic and musculoskeletal pathologies on X-rays, with subgroup analysis by age (including pediatric patients), sex, and country of acquisition.
title: International Multicenter Validation of an Expanded AI Diagnostic System for 18 Pathologies in Thoracic and Musculoskeletal Radiography.
headline_result: AUC >96.1% across all 18 pathologies; sensitivity 94.5-98.8%, specificity 84.6-96.1%

patient_population: 45 children with newly diagnosed neuroblastoma (2015-2024)
clinical_problem: Noninvasive initial risk stratification of pediatric neuroblastoma using MRI radiomics
model_description: Radiomic features (107 IBSI-compliant features) extracted from manually segmented T2-weighted MRI of pediatric neuroblastoma tumors, classified using Random Forest, XGBoost, and LDA+K-means clustering to stratify high-risk versus non-high-risk disease per INRG criteria.
title: Feasibility of T2-Weighted MRI Radiomics for Initial Risk Stratification in Pediatric Neuroblastoma.
headline_result: LDA+K-means: test accuracy 77.8%, sensitivity 64.7%, specificity 85.7%; agreement with conventional risk stratification 77.8%

patient_population: 3553 images (2103 lesion-positive, 1450 background-negative)
clinical_problem: Preoperative differentiation of Wilms tumor from neuroblastoma on pediatric abdominal CT
model_description: A YOLO26s object-detection model trained on preoperative contrast-enhanced CT images with histopathology-anchored labels to localize and differentiate Wilms tumor from neuroblastoma lesions.
title: AI-Assisted Preoperative Diagnosis of Wilms Tumor.
headline_result: Precision 0.954, recall 0.951, mAP@0.5 0.977; image-level tumor detection accuracy 95.3%

patient_population: 244 children under 3 years old with moderate or severe asthma
clinical_problem: Whether CT-based airway morphology can objectively classify asthma severity in young children
model_description: Machine learning classifier using quantitative airway wall thickness/ellipticity measurements from low-dose CT to classify moderate vs. severe asthma.
title: Correlation between the severity of asthma and computed tomography-based large airway structural changes among children under 3 years of age.
headline_result: AUC 0.83, accuracy 0.79 for classifying moderate vs. severe asthma

patient_population: 555 children (274 with ASD, 281 controls)
clinical_problem: Whether brief naturalistic-viewing fMRI can reveal neural signatures specific to autism symptoms for diagnostic purposes
model_description: Interpretable dual-stream deep learning network that classifies ASD vs. controls from 2-3 minutes of task fMRI during naturalistic movie viewing.
release_evidence: preprint, not yet published
title: Temporally-resolved deep learning reveals autism symptom-specific neural signatures during naturalistic social experiences.
study_design: retrospective case-control deep learning classification study
headline_result: >70% accuracy using 2-3 minutes of emotionally challenging fMRI stimuli, vs. 63% for resting-state scans

patient_population: Fetuses undergoing prenatal ultrasound (training and external validation cohorts)
clinical_problem: Automated detection of fetal corpus callosum abnormalities on prenatal ultrasound to assess fetal neurodevelopment
model_description: Deep learning framework combining automated region localization with a dual-stream architecture that analyzes multi-view ultrasound images to detect corpus callosum abnormalities, with Grad-CAM++ attention visualization.
title: Deep learning-based automated detection of fetal corpus callosum abnormalities in prenatal ultrasound.
study_design: retrospective model development with external validation
dataset_size: 496 training cases, 93 independent external test cases
headline_result: 97.36% accuracy on the external test set

body_region: fetal anatomy (head, neck, thorax, abdomen, extremities, spine)
patient_population: First-trimester fetuses imaged prospectively at four university hospitals in Korea
clinical_problem: Automated identification and segmentation of fetal anatomical structures in first-trimester ultrasound to support early anomaly screening
model_description: YOLACT-based real-time instance segmentation model that detects and segments fetal anatomical structures from first-trimester ultrasound images.
title: Deep Learning-Based Segmentation of Fetal Anatomical Structures in the First Trimester.
study_design: prospective multi-center dataset, retrospective model development with train/test split
headline_result: 98.4% overall anatomical detection accuracy; mAP@IoU0.5 0.622; 25.4 FPS

patient_population: Children under 18 years from the Bajio region of Mexico undergoing left-hand radiographs
clinical_problem: Whether an AI algorithm can objectively estimate bone age in children, eliminating interobserver variation
model_description: AI algorithm trained to estimate skeletal bone age from left-hand radiographs, compared against two expert observers using the Greulich and Pyle method.
journal: Revista medica del Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social
title: [Artificial intelligence algorithm for bone age estimation].
headline_result: No significant difference between AI and expert bone age estimates (p=0.68); no difference between chronological and bone age overall (p=0.12)

patient_population: Children enrolled in the TSC Autism Center of Excellence Research Network study
clinical_problem: Predicting autism diagnosis at 36 months in children with tuberous sclerosis complex from early diffusion MRI and behavioral data
model_description: Supervised learning models combining longitudinal diffusion tensor imaging metrics (interpolated to standardized ages via a two-step augmentation algorithm) with early behavioral assessment scores to predict autism diagnosis at 36 months.
title: A two-step temporal data augmentation and supervised learning framework for predicting autism diagnosis at 36 months in patients with tuberous sclerosis complex.
study_design: retrospective longitudinal supervised learning study on a small, heterogeneous clinical dataset

patient_population: 41 pediatric patients (48 renal units), ages 1 month to 18 years, with ureteropelvic junction obstruction
clinical_problem: Predicting the need for surgical intervention in children with ureteropelvic junction obstruction using diuretic ultrasound, avoiding unnecessary invasive workup
model_description: Interpretable machine learning model using renal excretion curve parameters derived from diuretic ultrasonography (e.g., area under the APD-excretion curve) to predict need for surgery; deployed as an interactive web application.
title: Diuretic Ultrasound Evaluation of Surgical Necessity in Pediatric Ureteropelvic Junction Obstruction.
study_design: retrospective model development with nested cross-validation
headline_result: SVM model AUC 0.984

patient_population: 43 adolescent idiopathic scoliosis patients (57 curves) from two centers
clinical_problem: Whether non-radiographic surface topography can predict Cobb angle progression in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis, reducing follow-up radiograph exposure
model_description: Random forest model using surface topography asymmetry parameters and angle of trunk rotation (not radiographic images) to predict future Cobb angle and classify curves as improving, stable, or progressing, aiming to reduce radiograph use.
journal: European spine journal : official publication of the European Spine Society, the European Spinal Deformity Society, and the European Section of the Cervical Spine Research Society
title: Advanced machine learning model for Cobb angle progression in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis with surface topography: a multicenter, prospective, observational study.
headline_result: 6-month Cobb angle prediction MAE 6.91-7.03 degrees; progression classification accuracy 80.7%

patient_population: 517 patients aged 1-14 years with forearm fractures
clinical_problem: Automated detection of forearm fractures on plain radiographs in children to help prevent missed fractures
model_description: CNN and Vision Transformer models (13 architectures compared) that classify frontal/lateral forearm radiographs as fracture-present or absent, with Grad-CAM/attention-map visualization.
title: Automated detection of pediatric forearm fractures in X-ray images using deep learning.
headline_result: Sensitivity 0.872, specificity 0.925, balanced accuracy 0.898, AUC 0.962 (VGG16)

patient_population: 132 patients with prenatal concern for coarctation (initial cohort), 64 in external validation cohort
clinical_problem: Predicting neonatal critical coarctation of the aorta from fetal echocardiogram measurements
model_description: Random forest classifier trained on eight fetal echocardiogram measurements plus gestational age to predict need for coarctation intervention within 30 days of life, with SHAP-based feature interpretation.
journal: Journal of the American Society of Echocardiography : official publication of the American Society of Echocardiography
title: Applying Machine Learning to Fetal Echocardiograms: A Novel Method for Predicting Critical Coarctation of the Aorta.
study_design: retrospective model development with external validation
headline_result: Internal AUC 0.95 (sensitivity 1.0, specificity 0.96); external validation sensitivity 0.81, specificity 0.98, F1 0.87

patient_population: 1,671 children from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) cohort
clinical_problem: Whether brain structural measures can distinguish children with cumulative early-life adversity and chronic pain from other groups
model_description: Support vector machine classifying children into control, pain-only, adversity-only, or combined groups using subcortical volume, cortical thickness, and surface area measures from structural MRI.
title: Cumulative impacts of early-life interpersonal adversity and persistent/recurrent pain in children: a longitudinal normative modelling study from the ABCD study cohort.
study_design: longitudinal normative modelling / cohort study with SVM classification
headline_result: SVM group classification did not exceed 66.8% accuracy

model_family: ensemble deep learning segmentation pipeline (radiomics-guided subtyping)
patient_population: Adult and pediatric patients with brain tumors (pediatric brain tumor consortium cohort plus meningioma and metastasis cohorts)
clinical_problem: Automated segmentation of diverse brain tumor types, including pediatric brain tumors, on multi-parametric MRI (BraTS 2025 Lighthouse Challenge)
model_description: Modular ensemble pipeline that selects and combines segmentation models with radiomic-feature-guided tumor subtyping and lesion-wise post-processing to segment brain tumors on multi-parametric MRI, including a dedicated pediatric brain tumor track.
journal: Segmentation, classification, and synthesis for brain tumors and traumatic brain injuries : MICCAI 2025 Challenges: BraTS-Lighthouse 2025 and AIMS-TBI 2025, held in conjunction with MICCAI 2025, Daejeon, South Korea, September 23, 2025,...
title: Adaptable Segmentation Pipeline for Diverse Brain Tumors with Radiomic-guided Subtyping and Lesion-Wise Model Ensemble.
study_design: challenge submission / benchmark segmentation pipeline evaluated on BraTS testing sets
headline_result: Performance comparable to top-ranked algorithms across multiple BraTS 2025 challenge tracks

patient_population: singleton pregnant women undergoing first-trimester NT screening
clinical_problem: Can an automated deep learning method accurately locate the correct imaging plane for first-trimester nuchal translucency screening?
model_description: CNN-based model (3D MSP-net) automatically extracts the fetal mid-sagittal plane from 3D ultrasound volumes using intracranial structure segmentation, to standardize nuchal translucency measurement.
journal: Journal of ultrasound in medicine : official journal of the American Institute of Ultrasound in Medicine
title: Feasibility and Reproducibility of a Structure-Guided Deep Learning Model for Automatic Detection of the Standard Sagittal Plane in First-Trimester Nuchal Translucency Assessment Using 3D Ultrasound.
study_design: prospective method development and validation study
headline_result: 91.6% MSP extraction success rate; NT measurement 1.4±0.5 mm (2D manual) vs 1.4±0.4 mm (3D MSP-net), p=.444

clinical_problem: Can a prenatal ultrasound-based risk model identify fetuses with hypoplastic left heart syndrome?

journal: Journal of ultrasound in medicine : official journal of the American Institute of Ultrasound in Medicine
title: Multimodal Nomogram for the Prenatal Risk Assessment of Hypoplastic Left Heart Syndrome Using Self-Supervised Learning.
headline_result: Accuracy 0.935, AUC 0.991

model_family: brain-age regression model (nonlinear neurodevelopmental trajectory model)
patient_population: 126 children with drug-resistant epilepsy treated with vagus nerve stimulation (multicenter); brain-age model trained on 2,623 individuals aged 1.9-90 years
clinical_problem: Whether a brain-age biomarker predicts response to vagus nerve stimulation in children with drug-resistant epilepsy
model_description: Pediatric-specific brain-age model trained on structural MRI to estimate a brain-age gap (BrainAGEgap), applied to children with drug-resistant epilepsy to predict response to vagus nerve stimulation.
title: Brain-age defines a structural signature of outcomes after vagus nerve stimulation in children.
study_design: multicenter cohort study with pediatric brain-age model development and independent validation
dataset_size: 126 children with DRE (multicenter VNS cohort); brain-age model trained/validated on 2,623 individuals
headline_result: Brain-age model R2=0.93, MAE=3.5 years (independent pediatric validation MAE=2.16 years); lower pre-surgical BrainAGEgap predicted VNS response (p=0.01)

patient_population: 4 healthy adult volunteers and 2 children with cystic fibrosis
clinical_problem: Can a noncontrast MRI technique reliably map lung ventilation and perfusion defects, including in children with cystic fibrosis?
model_description: A physics-driven spatiotemporal neural network (VQ-Wave) estimates ventilation and perfusion maps from noncontrast functional lung MRI signal, without requiring contrast agents.
title: VQ-Wave: A Physics-Driven Spatiotemporal Deep Learning Approach for Noncontrast-Enhanced Lung Ventilation and Perfusion MRI.
study_design: technical method development with small in vivo validation
headline_result: Global mean variation <12% even with scan time reduced from 45s to 15s

patient_population: 346 children with febrile urinary tract infection
clinical_problem: Noninvasive risk stratification for vesicoureteral reflux from renal DMSA scintigraphy patterns, to reduce need for voiding cystourethrography

journal: Journal of cellular and molecular medicine
title: Noninvasive Risk Stratification Based on Renal Tubular Injury Phenotypes: A Deep Learning Study for Predicting Vesicoureteral Reflux in Children.
headline_result: Accuracy 0.8290 (severe-side input), 0.7997 (bilateral-side input)

patient_population: Pregnant women assessed for placenta accreta spectrum across 14 reviewed studies
clinical_problem: Reviewing machine learning approaches for early prenatal diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum using ultrasound and MRI
model_description: Narrative review summarizing 14 studies of linear, ensemble, deep learning, and hybrid machine learning models applied to ultrasound and MRI for early diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum; no single model.
title: Machine Learning in Maternity: Early Diagnosis of Placenta Accreta Spectrum.
headline_result: Ultrasound-based ML models 84.6-92.3% accuracy; MRI-based texture analysis (k-NN) up to 98.1% accuracy

patient_population: Pediatric populations across 14 studies (1,434,840 subjects total)
clinical_problem: Systematic review of deep learning for screening, diagnosis, and management of ventricular septal defect in children
model_description: Systematic review of CNN-based deep learning applications (prenatal echocardiography, phonocardiograms, chest radiographs) for detecting and risk-stratifying ventricular septal defect in children; no single model.
title: A systematic review on deep learning in ventricular septal defect screening, diagnosis, and management.
headline_result: Prenatal echo CNNs up to 100% sensitivity/98% accuracy for VSD detection; chest X-ray CNN AUC 0.91 differentiating ASD/VSD; closure-prediction AUC 0.98

patient_population: Pediatric patients undergoing Doppler echocardiography at four medical centers
clinical_problem: Automated detection of patent ductus arteriosus from Doppler echocardiography videos
model_description: Two-stage TimeSformer-based transformer framework that first identifies the parasternal short-axis view, then classifies Doppler echocardiography video sequences as PDA-positive or negative.
journal: Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
title: Automated Detection of Patent Ductus Arteriosus in Pediatric Patients Using Doppler Ultrasonography Videos Based on a Transformer Model.
study_design: retrospective multi-center model development and validation
headline_result: AUC 0.95 for PDA detection across four centers and four ultrasound devices

patient_population: Children and young people undergoing abdominal proton beam therapy (training cohort ages 0-16, external cohorts ages 2-24)
clinical_problem: Predicting internal gastrointestinal gas changes from radiographs as a surrogate for radiotherapy dose degradation during abdominal proton beam therapy in children
model_description: Deep learning (CNN and dual U-Net) models trained on simulated frontal/lateral radiographs (from CT) to predict internal GI gas volume and path length, validated on real clinical radiographs from two international radiotherapy institutions.

dataset_size: 349 pediatric CTs (Paediatric-CT-SEG) for development; 21 (Europe) and 14 (Asia) external radiotherapy patients

patient_population: Children undergoing abdominal radiographs at seven tertiary hospitals (2012-2022)
clinical_problem: Detecting intussusception and splenomegaly on pediatric abdominal radiographs to support emergency triage
model_description: EfficientDet-B2-based deep learning models (independent binary classifiers, multiclass, and transfer-learning strategies) that classify abdominal radiographs for intussusception and splenomegaly.
journal: Journal of imaging informatics in medicine
title: Transfer learning for Multi-institutional Classification of Intussusception and Splenomegaly in Pediatric Abdominal Radiographs.
study_design: retrospective multi-institutional model development with locked external test set
headline_result: Internal AUC 0.851 (intussusception)/0.834 (splenomegaly); locked external AUC 0.818/0.806

patient_population: 192 children undergoing renal ultrasound and DMSA scintigraphy
clinical_problem: Predicting DMSA-detected renal scarring from multiparametric ultrasound to reduce need for scintigraphy
model_description: Supervised machine learning models trained on renal morphometric/volumetric ultrasound parameters and shear wave elastography, with data augmentation, to predict DMSA-detected renal scarring.
title: Multiparametric Ultrasound and Machine Learning for Predicting Renal Scarring in Children.

patient_population: 22 healthy girls (182 MRIs) and 44 healthy boys (266 MRIs), median age 13
clinical_problem: Automated volumetric segmentation of gonads on MRI in healthy adolescents to characterize pubertal anatomical change
model_description: Two open-source 3D nnU-Net models that segment ovaries, ovarian cysts, and testicles on T2-weighted (and fat-saturated T2) MRI, with volumes computed automatically.
release_evidence: "developed two open-source AI models to segment bilateral gonads"
title: Artificial Intelligence-Based Approach for Automated Gonad Volume Quantification Using Magnetic Resonance Imaging in Healthy Adolescents Across Puberty.
dataset_size: 182 MRIs from 22 girls; 266 MRIs from 44 boys
headline_result: Dice: ovary 0.86, cyst 0.69, testicle 0.90

patient_population: 340 pediatric brain tumor cases (143 low-grade, 197 high-grade)
clinical_problem: Preoperative grading (low- vs. high-grade) of pediatric brain tumors from multi-sequence MRI

title: Interpretability and performance of a 3D C-vit model for accurate grading of pediatric brain tumors.

patient_population: 288 patients with autoimmune abnormalities, 2019-2024
clinical_problem: Predicting adverse pregnancy outcomes in women with autoimmune abnormalities using first-trimester sonographic features
model_description: Nine machine learning models (best: extreme gradient boosting) using first-trimester sonographic measurements (crown-rump length, gestational sac volume, yolk sac diameter change) plus clinical data to predict adverse pregnancy outcomes, interpreted with SHAP.
title: Adverse Pregnancy Outcomes in Women With Immune Abnormalities: Machine Learning Model Development and Validation Using First-Trimester Sonographic Features.
study_design: retrospective model development and SHAP interpretation study

patient_population: 38 children with overweight/obesity and 68 normal-weight children; exact age range not stated
clinical_problem: predicting 1-year eating-behavior outcomes in children with obesity from reward/inhibitory-control brain connectivity
model_description: Input is resting-state functional connectivity and dynamic-causal-modeling-derived effective connectivity between prefrontal cortex and caudate, in children with and without overweight/obesity. A machine-learning approach uses baseline connectivity between these regions to predict changes in eating behavior one year later. The abstract reports that baseline caudate-prefrontal connections were predictive of behavior change but gives no numeric accuracy.
title: Altered effective connectivity between the prefrontal cortex and caudate in children with overweight and obesity.

model_family: CNN-based lung nodule detection (compared with MONAI)
patient_population: 75 pediatric CT scans (pediatric cancer patients)
clinical_problem: Detecting small lung nodules and micronodules, indicative of metastatic cancer, on CT in pediatric oncology patients

clinical_problem: Methodological framework for mapping individualized brain morphological connectivity at the voxel level, evaluated in part in children with autism

title: A radiomics-based method for studying seed-based voxel-wise morphological connectivity.
study_design: methodological development and validation study across three independent datasets

patient_population: 262 neonates with necrotizing enterocolitis, 2016-2022
clinical_problem: Predicting surgical risk and timing in neonates with necrotizing enterocolitis using radiomics features from abdominal radiographs
model_description: Radiomics features extracted from abdominal radiographs at NEC diagnosis, combined via LASSO and Cox regression into a risk score and nomogram, to predict surgical risk and timing over 1-7 weeks.
title: Cox regression model for predicting the surgical risk and timing of necrotizing enterocolitis based on abdominal radiographs radiomics features.
headline_result: Nomogram AUC 0.716-0.744 (training), 0.668-0.733 (test)

model_family: deep learning volumetric segmentation with synthetic domain adaptation
patient_population: Postmortem (ex vivo) infant brain MRI dataset
clinical_problem: Automated anatomical segmentation and cortical surface reconstruction of high-resolution postmortem infant brain MRI
model_description: Unified deep learning framework combining volumetric segmentation with surface-based cortical reconstruction for postmortem infant brain MRI, using a postmortem-specific synthetic data generation engine (PostSynth) to address domain shift; benchmarked against existing contrast-agnostic/foundational segmentation models.
release_evidence: "the code is publicly available as part of the purple-mri package"
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
title: Cortical reconstruction and anatomical parcellation of high-resolution multi-modal postmortem ex vivo MRI of the human infant brain.

patient_population: 1,087 normal spines (CTSpine1K) plus 138 clinical AIS cases (Cobb angles 15-85 degrees) and 38 real biplanar X-ray cases
clinical_problem: 3D reconstruction of the scoliotic spine from two orthogonal (biplanar) X-rays to avoid CT radiation in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis assessment

title: Multi-scale generative adversarial network: three-dimensional reconstruction of the scoliotic spine from biplanar X-rays.

dataset_size: 1,087 normal spines (CTSpine1K) + 138 AIS cases + 38 real biplanar X-ray cases
headline_result: PSNR 73.20 dB (+12.2% vs. baseline), SSIM 0.956 (+5.5%), Dice 0.92 (+8%); mean differences SVA -0.198 mm, LL 0.087 deg, TK 0.095 deg on real clinical X-rays

model_family: logistic regression with Boruta/LASSO/XGBoost feature selection
patient_population: Pregnant women from a tertiary hospital in Kunming, 2022-2023
clinical_problem: Predicting spontaneous preterm birth using cervical length and cervical elastography ultrasound features
model_description: Machine learning feature-selection algorithms (Boruta, LASSO, sliding-window forward selection, XGBoost) applied to cervical length, cervical angle, and elastography strain-rate measurements to build a logistic regression model predicting spontaneous preterm birth.

clinical_problem: Can a generative AI model predict how a child's diffuse midline glioma will grow on future MRI scans, to help plan radiotherapy?
